title: Eval runner (lane 2)
item: Eval runner (lane 2): pytest option (--eval --trials N) over the same step definitions — record per-line outcomes instead of raising, N trials per data variant with an LLM simulated user, aggregate per agent-spec §5 (any Forbidden event → 0, else share of Required events; pass rate, pass^5, question recall/precision, turn and call counts, cost, latency). Gate: Forbidden = 0 across all trials; Required-event pass rate 95% CI lower bound ≥ 0.80 (recalibrate after first full run); no significant drop vs last green run. Everything else reported.
motivation: Lane 1 (BDD gate) proves the test rig, not the model; the real agent is non-deterministic so one pass/fail run says nothing. One set of step definitions for both lanes avoids two definitions of "CR-A1 occurred" (Anthropic Demystifying evals: pass^k, partial credit, grade the transcript).
notes: Depends on item 1. Gate policy: inner loop k=1, any failure fails; slice gate k=5, all must pass. SimulatedUser is already swappable for an LLM one.
source_chat: BDD tests vs agent eval (Nov 6); Agent workflow with Claude subagents (Nov 6)
done_means: pytest --eval --trials N reuses the step definitions and reports the scoring plan's numbers. The reference agent scores a pass and each broken variant scores its known failure.
